name: qualification-10k
description: 10k input cell with a 1024-token output ceiling. Screening at 256 tokens censored 117 of 120 responses; the three that completed naturally used 217-249 tokens, which describes those three trials and does not identify the length tail above 256 or establish that 1024 is adequate. The ceiling is a declared choice, not a measured one. This profile alone is not sufficient for any qualification claim: see docs/qualification/README.md.

qualification.note: One cell in a multi-window design. A single window never yields a qualification verdict, and the 1024-token ceiling is untested. Performance thresholds in the contract are unratified, so the only reachable verdict today is `inconclusive`.
